authored_discipline: Indices, controls, sigma, and decision rule fixed from the SEGMENTED TEXT ALONE, before building the conditioned null or running any scoring. Pre-registration per ADR-SKM-0003 verdict discipline; this is what makes the both-ways-decisive claim hold and bounds the comparison count to the named indices.

punchline_notes.72: 'With a torch.' — canonical deadpan snap; joke requires the cellar/darkness setup at 70-71 (so expected k* ~ 2-3).
punchline_notes.74: 'So had the stairs.' — deadpan snap; requires the 'go down to the cellar' setup at 70.

control_equal_format_notes: SET_QUOTE short dialogue (len 4-7), same stratum as the punchlines but mundane (not comedic discontinuities). Must NOT clear when a punchline does — this is the within-stratum specificity test (confound 2).
control_scene_shift_notes: TERM_FLOW cloud/shadow narration — the magnitude channel's known scene-shift over-firers (the original 2026-06-15 flat finding's max-acceleration landed on this kind of narration). Different stratum; a cross-stratum sanity that the punchline spike is not merely the magnitude channel doing its scene-shift thing.
flag_sigma_note: Matches jolt.py default threshold_sigma; fixed before scoring.
decision_rule: POSITIVE iff a punchline index (72 or 74) clears sigma>=3.0 in its (k, length_bucket, demarcator_class) stratum at some k* AND stays cleared CONTIGUOUSLY across the usable-k band above k* (an isolated single-k crossing is rejected as per-cell stratum noise), WHILE at those k (i) the equal-format controls do NOT clear and (ii) the punchline's immediate neighbors do NOT clear (local calm-SPIKE-calm isolation = the deadpan shape, not mere spike-existence). NEGATIVE iff no punchline meets this under sigma=3.0.

verdict_cell.note: The punchlines' own stratum. confound 6: n in THIS cell must be checked; if the conditioned null backs off below the demarcator level here, the verdict drops to the weaker bound ('magnitude can't separate comedic from scene discontinuity at equal formatting' -> 'judged against everything').

excluded_with_reason.78: '...Beware of the Leopard.' — the famous capstone, but the segmenter keeps it as one 37-token quote block (length 16+), so the punchline is diluted across the block and is NOT a clean short-snap test at this atom. A finer (intra-quote) split would be needed to test it; recorded as a limitation, not tested this run.
excluded_with_reason.71: 'That's the display department.' — comedic straight-line adjacent to 72; left as a neighbor (isolation check), not a registered punchline, to avoid adjacent-punchline contamination of the neighbor-non-clearance criterion.

verdict_outcome: NEGATIVE (2026-06-16). Neither punchline (72,74) clears sigma=3.0 in its finest-level (k|4-7|SET_QUOTE, n=1368) stratum at any k; equal-format controls and scene-shift controls also stay within ~1 sigma. Per the pre-registered bound: magnitude cannot separate comedic from scene/ordinary discontinuity AT EQUAL FORMATTING (NOT 'no signal'). Sub-finding: punchline 72's z rises monotonically with k (-1.66 -> +0.82, ~2.5 sigma in the predicted direction) but stays sub-threshold; 74 does not. Result artifact: output/ramp_deadpan_bypass_result.json. Cleanest case yet for bearing-not-magnitude; aims at the projection/situatedness track (ADR-SKM-0001, unbuilt anchor).
